messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a recurring mismatch between metered tokens and invoice line items for acct-team-phi after yesterday's routing rollouts. Numbers look like stream completions got double-counted in some cases. anyone seen this?

maya: saw that too. smaller subset of requests only. happens when requests use function-calls + streaming. billing events show both 'stream.delta' and a final 'stream.complete' that contains a summed total. feels like double-aggregation. :thinking_face:

sanjay: that would explain the delta. our ingest aggregator currently groups by request_id and event_type. if 'stream.delta' and 'stream.complete' are both emitted w/ different event_type we just SUM() them. we should ensure the final event replaces the deltas or that deltas are flagged as partial.

alex: agree. quick debug logs:
```
[ingest] request_id=r-Kjd92 stream_id=s-11 event=stream.delta delta_tokens=14 seq=3
[ingest] request_id=r-Kjd92 stream_id=s-11 event=stream.delta delta_tokens=12 seq=4
[ingest] request_id=r-Kjd92 stream_id=s-11 event=stream.complete total_tokens=26
```
So we currently count 14+12+26=52 tokens, when actual should be 26.

maya: the root cause is the schema ambiguity. producers send both deltas and a final summary, but we never set a canonical dedup key. plus our default agg window (1m) sometimes spans the whole session which hides ordering guarantees.

sanjay: proposed fix: ingest should emit idempotent token events with these fields: request_id, stream_segment_id, event_seq, event_type, tokens_delta, aggregate_final boolean. aggregation should dedupe by (request_id, stream_segment_id, event_seq) and when aggregate_final=true, drop prior deltas for that segment and use final_total. I'll open a PR.

elaine: heads-up from billing — any changes to how we produce invoice line-items need a migration plan. customers have already queried two invoices. we should plan retroactive fixes (credit notes) if we change aggregation semantics. also need to ensure line-item ids are stable across re-aggregation.

alex: good point. we should include invoice_reference_id in the meter records so billing can reconcile. also add a flag 'reconciled_by' in the invoice pipeline.

billing-bot: [automated] alert: invoice mismatch detected for customer acct-team-phi. diff=+26 tokens on 2025-11-05, severity=medium. ticket# BI-452 created.

maya: other edge cases: retries and failover routing. If a request is replayed after routing fallback, we sometimes see two independent request_ids for what the console treats as 1 logical request. need a way to correlate via client_provided_id or trace_id.

sanjay: agreed. recommend: require producers to set client_request_id for user-initiated requests. server-side routing can append attempt_count, but meter uses client_request_id as the canonical grouping key. For legacy producers, fallback to request_id but mark as non-dedupable.

alex: UX/console implications: rollouts show estimated cost delta on a per-route basis. currently estimates are based on raw token emission (including deltas). until we fix aggregation, the console will overstate cost change for routes that use streaming. we should show a confidence interval and a "reconciled" badge when we've validated sample invoices.

elaine: also need a dashboard metric: token_ingest_lag and token_dedupe_rate. Ops should run a nightly reconciliation job that compares aggregated tokens vs invoiced tokens per account and surfaces >1% diffs.

maya: quick SQL I used to demonstrate the bug (adb):
```sql
SELECT request_id, SUM(tokens) as counted, SUM(CASE WHEN is_final=1 THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) as finals
FROM meter_events
WHERE ts >= '2025-11-05'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING counted != finals
LIMIT 50;
```
returned ~120 rows for the day.

sanjay: action items I'll own:
- add stream_segment_id + event_seq to event schema (PR by EOD)
- aggregator: dedupe and prefer final_total when present (integration tests)
- add client_request_id support for routing-retries

alex: I'll coordinate with billing and product to draft the migration plan and credits flow. need ETA on data backfill if we change aggregation.

elaine: please include a runbook for emergency rev-credits if numbers spike. also copy finance on the PR review.

maya: I'll add dashboard panels and a Prometheus gauge for 'metering.dedup_failure_count' and alert when >50/day.

billing-bot: [automated] ticket BI-452 updated: assigned to sanjay, priority=P1.

alex: thanks all. if anyone finds more examples, paste raw events here and tag me. I'll suspend the routing rollout for the affected route until we have a fix. :white_check_mark:
